designationHistory.name: Bitter Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 7724 reserving about 21,869 acres in Chaves County, New Mexico, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Bitter Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Bitter Lake NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 1998 (ServCat 145864)
